body:
## Why

Triage is where cards wait for a human'"'"'s yes, and nothing tells the human what is waiting or why. Finding it by
hand means reading ~78 KB of `hkb list --status triage --json` or running `hkb show` twenty times. CLAUDE.md calls
a rung that is possible but tedious a bug.

The arithmetic half of that judgement needs no LLM: whether every blocker is closed as completed, whether
`kb.paths` is empty, whether the body has a spec shape, which cards name each other, which pairs share files.
It belongs in `src/model.js` beside `blockerDone`, `computeReady`, `priorityOf` and `pathsOverlap`, which
already live there. This card is that half and only that half: pure functions and their tests, no I/O, no CLI.

## What

Per #191'"'"'s *What* section 1, amended. Add after `sortForDispatch` in `src/model.js`:

- The helpers: `blocksIndex(tasks)`, `ageDays(task, now)`, `specShape(bodyText)`, `cardMentions(text, openNumbers)`,
  `pathHubs(tasks, share = 0.25)`, `pathJaccard(a, b, hubs)`. **No `detectCycles`** — amendment 1 says to reuse the
  walk in `src/track.js` (import it, or lift it into `model.js` and have `track.js` call it).
- `GROOM_KINDS` with the exact kinds and levels #191 lists, as amended: `unblocked` (act; requires
  `blockedBy.length >= 1`), `no_blockers`/`unknown_blockers` (info), `dead_blocker`/`blocker_in_triage`/
  `priority_inversion`/`thin_spec`/`merged_pr_open`/`broad_path` (ask), `no_paths`/`malformed_kb`/`cycle`/
  `two_agents`/`blocker_off_board` (act), `no_goal` (act only when `specShape` finds no Done-when heading, else
  info), and the two shortlists `mentions_unlinked` and `overlap_pair` (always `needs_judgment`).
- `proposeAction(card)` → one `GROOM_ACTIONS` value, or `judge`, or `none`.
- `groomBoard(tasks, opts)` assembling the report object #191 specifies. `blocksIndex` and mentions are computed
  over **all** tasks passed in; `statuses` filters only which cards get a row.

Everything is pure: an injected `now`, no dates from the clock, no network, no `ctx`.

## Done when

- [ ] `test/groom.test.js` has one fixture case per `GROOM_KINDS` kind, including a zero-blocker triage card that
      must **not** match `unblocked`; a NOT_PLANNED blocker → `dead_blocker`, never `unblocked`; `no_goal` as
      `info` when a Done-when heading exists; hub removal at 25%; mentions minus blockers minus children.
- [ ] `proposeAction`'"'"'s table is pinned by a test, and every value it returns is in `GROOM_ACTIONS`.
- [ ] `groomBoard` makes no I/O and takes only the array plus options; a test passes it a plain fixture array.
- [ ] `npm run lint && npm test` pass. No file outside `src/model.js` and `test/groom.test.js` changes.

## Contract

These are the names, signatures and rules a sibling depends on. Do not invent alternatives; a change here
breaks a task you cannot see.

- **The eleven "Amendments from the adversarial pass" at the top of #191 override its body wherever they
  differ.** Read `hkb show 191` first and treat the amendments as the specification. In particular: reuse
  `computeReady`, `agentsOf` and the walk in `src/track.js` — **do not write `detectCycles`**; `no_goal` is
  `info` when the body already has a Done-when heading; `broad_path` exists and is `ask`; `overlap_pair.why` is
  guard-aware.
- `groomBoard(tasks, { now, caps, pairs = 10, statuses })` is exported from `src/model.js` and takes the raw
  `fetchBoard` array and nothing else — a later card puts the same function behind `hkb serve`'s snapshot.
- `GROOM_KINDS` and `GROOM_ACTIONS` are exported from `src/model.js`. Actions are the closed vocabulary
  `promote · specify · link-under · split · supersede · reprioritise · park · archive`, plus `judge` and `none`.
- `fetchBoard(ctx, { blockers: 'all' })` REST-fills blockers for **every open card** on a repo without GraphQL
  `blockedBy`; `blockers: true` keeps today's todo/blocked-only behaviour.
- The `--json` field names in #191 are **frozen**; later kinds are added to `findings`, never renamed.
- The CLI never emits the word "duplicate". `overlap_pair.why` is "will serialize under path_overlap".
- **`src/dispatch.js` is untouched by this whole track** — the promote step still filters `status === 'todo'`.
- Nothing in this track writes to the board. `hkb groom` is a read, like `hkb dispatch --dry-run`.
goal: groomBoard(tasks,{now,caps,pairs,statuses}) and GROOM_KINDS/GROOM_ACTIONS are exported from src/model.js, pure and I/O-free, with one fixture test per kind including the false-positive cases the amendments name
title: groomBoard, GROOM_KINDS and the pure grooming helpers in model.js
